notes: Motion & background preset library. `snippet` is a self-contained, zero-JS CSS/HTML port injected into generated single-file sites; class names are prefixed .vm-{id}- and theme colors come in through var(--vm-c1)/var(--vm-c2). Seed entries are Velpi originals; harvested entries carry their source + license. HARVEST NOTES (2026-07-03): Added 21 presets. Magic UI (MIT, verified LICENSE.md), KokonutUI (MIT), SmoothUI (MIT), Motion Primitives (MIT per README license section), Vanta.js (MIT, LICENSE.md), tsParticles (MIT). SKIPPED React Bits (DavidHDev/react-bits) and Animate UI (imskyleen/animate-ui): both are 'MIT + Commons Clause' which forbids selling/redistributing the components themselves alone or in a bundle - incompatible with shipping them in this preset library. Aceternity UI not harvested: its free components are not published in a permissively-licensed public repo, so redistribution rights are unclear. RE-VERIFICATION (2026-07-04, license texts fetched again at user request): React Bits LICENSE.md verbatim header 'MIT + Commons Clause License Condition v1.0' with restriction 'you do not sell, sublicense, or redistribute the components themselves-whether alone, in a bundle, or as a ported version' — skip stands. Animate UI (imskyleen/animate-ui) LICENSE.md verbatim header 'MIT + Commons Clause License Condition' with restriction 'you do not sell or redistribute the components themselves in their original form—whether alone or in a bundle' (GitHub SPDX: NOASSERTION) — skip stands. Aceternity UI: official ui.aceternity.com/licence page is a custom 'Aceternity License' ('You cannot re-distribute the Item as a stock image or its source files'; 'You cannot sell, resell, or distribute the Item or derivative works on any marketplace'); no MIT grant found on any official surface (registry.json has no license field; /license URL 404s; no official permissively-licensed repo) — skip stands. None of the three is plain MIT; nothing harvested from them.

presets.snippet: <style>.vm-tilt-hover{transition:transform .35s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1),box-shadow .35s;transform-style:preserve-3d;will-change:transform}.vm-tilt-hover:hover{transform:perspective(900px) rotateX(4deg) rotateY(-6deg) translateY(-4px);box-shadow:0 24px 50px -18px color-mix(in srgb,var(--vm-c1) 55%,transparent)}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.vm-tilt-hover{transition:none}.vm-tilt-hover:hover{transform:translateY(-3px)}}</style><!-- apply class to a feature/product card -->

presets.name: Glow Lift
presets.summary: A card that lifts and reveals a soft brand-color glow ring on hover
presets.snippet: <style>.vm-glow-lift{position:relative;transition:transform .3s,box-shadow .3s}.vm-glow-lift::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:inherit;opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb,var(--vm-c1) 40%,transparent),0 18px 40px -16px color-mix(in srgb,var(--vm-c2) 60%,transparent);pointer-events:none}.vm-glow-lift:hover{transform:translateY(-5px)}.vm-glow-lift:hover::after{opacity:1}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.vm-glow-lift{transition:none}.vm-glow-lift:hover{transform:none}}</style><!-- apply class to a card or CTA -->

presets.name: Conic Border
presets.summary: A featured card ringed by a continuously rotating conic gradient border
presets.snippet: <style>@property --vm-cbr-a{syntax:'<angle>';initial-value:0deg;inherits:false}.vm-conic-border-rotate{position:relative;border-radius:16px;isolation:isolate}.vm-conic-border-rotate::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:inherit;padding:1.5px;background:conic-gradient(from var(--vm-cbr-a),var(--vm-c1),var(--vm-c2),var(--vm-c1));-webkit-mask:linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box,linear-gradient(#000 0 0);-webkit-mask-composite:xor;mask-composite:exclude;animation:vm-cbr-spin 5s linear infinite;pointer-events:none}@keyframes vm-cbr-spin{to{--vm-cbr-a:360deg}}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.vm-conic-border-rotate::before{animation:none}}</style><!-- apply class to the ONE featured/highlighted card -->

presets.name: Clip Reveal
presets.summary: A hero image or block that unveils with a top-to-bottom curtain wipe on load
presets.snippet: <style>.vm-clip-reveal{clip-path:inset(0 0 100% 0);animation:vm-clip-in 1s .2s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1) forwards}@keyframes vm-clip-in{to{clip-path:inset(0 0 0 0)}}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.vm-clip-reveal{clip-path:none;animation:none}}</style><!-- apply to a hero image or a section block for a curtain reveal -->

presets.name: Reveal On Scroll
presets.summary: Sections fade and rise as they scroll into view using native CSS scroll-driven animation (degrades to fully visible)
presets.snippet: <style>.vm-reveal-on-scroll{opacity:1}@supports (animation-timeline:view()){.vm-reveal-on-scroll{opacity:0;transform:translateY(24px);animation:vm-ros-in linear both;animation-timeline:view();animation-range:entry 0% entry 45%}@keyframes vm-ros-in{to{opacity:1;transform:none}}}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.vm-reveal-on-scroll{opacity:1!important;transform:none!important;animation:none!important}}</style><!-- apply to each section or card; native scroll-driven, no JS, safely visible where unsupported -->

presets.name: Parallax Scroll

presets.snippet: <style>.vm-parallax-scroll{opacity:1}@supports (animation-timeline:view()){.vm-parallax-scroll{animation:vm-parallax linear both;animation-timeline:view();animation-range:cover}@keyframes vm-parallax{from{transform:translateY(-6%)}to{transform:translateY(6%)}}}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.vm-parallax-scroll{animation:none;transform:none}}</style><!-- apply to a background image INSIDE an overflow-hidden framed section -->
